verdict.rationale: Ramp offers strong vendor evidence for AI-driven automation relevant to closing books faster—auto-receipt capture, invoice matching/coding/approval, and real-time bidirectional ERP sync eliminating manual journal entries—plus customer proof points on faster onboarding and tool consolidation. However, these are all vendor-claimed docs with no independent/community validation specifically on accounting close speed, and community commentary focuses on expense tracking rather than close automation.
